title: Etaleness descends through a surjective etale source cover
statement: Let $T,X,Y$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $h:X\to T$ and $p:Y\to X$ be morphisms. If $p$ is surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism] and etale [def-weil-etale-morphism], and $h\circ p$ is etale, then $h$ is etale. No separation, finite-type or Noetherian hypothesis is imposed on $T$, $X$ or $Y$.

source.place: Tag 036W, lemma-etale-etale-local-source, applied to the singleton etale covering p.
